passives.desc:
When your team has at least one <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>, or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> character, the {LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter</color> will be enhanced based on the number of characters of each corresponding element.
Jahoda secretly keeps track of these characters. Among them, the element with the highest number of characters determines the enhancement effect:
· <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>: <color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> deal 130% of their original DMG.
· <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>: <color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> heal for 120% of their original healing amount.
· <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>: The number of <color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> increases by one.
· <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>: The attack interval of <color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> is reduced by 10%.

If there's a tie between elements, the order of priority that determines which enhancement takes effect is: <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>, then <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>. Only one elemental effect can initially be triggered.
passives.name: Plan to Get Paid

passives.desc: When a {LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter</color> triggers healing on an active team member, if that character's HP is above 70%, their Elemental Mastery will be increased by 100 for 6s.
passives.name: Sweet Berry Bounty

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Performs a more precise <color=#FFD780FF>Aimed Shot</color> with increased DMG.
While aiming, mighty winds will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged wind arrow will deal <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, hitting opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Strike While the Arrow's Hot

skills.desc: Jahoda dashes toward her opponent, entering the Shadow Pursuit state upon contact. While in this state, Jahoda moves continuously and swiftly: If nearby opponents are affected by Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo, she will quietly convert her {LINK#N11240001}Purr-loined Treasure Flask{/LINK} to that element, gradually filling it. When the duration ends or the skill is used again, Jahoda drains the Purr-loined Treasure Flask and deals a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask is full, Jahoda immediately drains it, exiting the Shadow Pursuit state and dealing a more powerful instance of Anemo DMG. If her dash fails to make contact with an opponent, Jahoda instead drops a Smoke Bomb at her location, dealing a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask becomes full, Jahoda will not immediately discharge it. Instead, for a short duration, she steadily consumes the stored element inside and periodically fires Fluffy Meowballs at nearby opponents, dealing DMG of the corresponding element stored in the Purr-loined Treasure Flask. When a Fluffy Meowball hits an opponent, Jahoda regenerates 2 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 3.5s. There are many ways to divide wealth in this world — but for Nod-Krai's treasure hunters — and hoarders — only one has ever proven sufficiently effective.
skills.name: Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils

skills.desc: Time to reveal those pocket aces! Jahoda retrieves 2 {LINK#N11240002}Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots{/LINK} and deals a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents.\n\n"Coordinated assistance? It means you 'assist' some Mora our way, and we handle the 'coordination.' Makes purrfect sense, don't you agree?"
skills.name: Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter

hyperlinks.description:
A small elemental vessel that Jahoda retrieves after casting her Elemental Skill Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils.
While Jahoda is in the Shadow Pursuit state, if nearby opponents are affected by Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo, the Purr-loined Treasure Flask will convert to that element and begin filling up. The order of priority that determines which element will be converted to is: Pyro, Hydro, Electro, then Cryo. After each use of her Elemental Skill, the Purr-loined Treasure Flask can undergo one such conversion.
When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask is full, Jahoda immediately drains it, exiting the Shadow Pursuit state and dealing a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents.
Each time the Elemental Skill is cast, Jahoda takes out a brand-new Purr-loined Treasure Flask.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask becomes full, Jahoda will not immediately discharge it. Instead, for a short duration, she steadily consumes the stored element inside and periodically fires Fluffy Meowballs at nearby opponents, dealing DMG of the corresponding element stored in the Purr-loined Treasure Flask.
hyperlinks.name: Purr-loined Treasure Flask

hyperlinks.description:
One of the gadgets that Jahoda — a former treasure hunter — carries around with her. It is deployed upon using her Elemental Burst Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter.
Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots continuously restore HP to your active character. If the healed character's HP is above 70%, they also restore HP to the nearby party member with the lowest HP.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: If nearby opponents are affected by Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo, Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots will convert to that element. The order of priority that determines which element will be converted to is: Pyro, Hydro, Electro, then Cryo. After each deployment, a Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot can undergo one such conversion. After converting, the Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot will periodically attack up to 3 nearby opponents, dealing damage of the corresponding element.
hyperlinks.name: Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots

hyperlinks.description:
雅珂达施放元素战技奇策·财富分配方案后取出的小型元素瓶。
雅珂达处于「掠影追袭」状态下时，若附近的敌人处于火元素、水元素、雷元素或冰元素附着下，呼噜噜秘藏瓶会转化为对应的元素类型，并持续进行装填，且会按照火元素、水元素、雷元素、冰元素的优先级进行转化。每次施放元素战技后，呼噜噜秘藏瓶至多能进行一次转化。
呼噜噜秘藏瓶装满时，雅珂达将会退出「掠影追袭」状态，对附近的敌人造成一次风元素伤害，并清空呼噜噜秘藏瓶。
每次施放元素战技时，雅珂达都会重新取出一个新的呼噜噜秘藏瓶。

月兆·满辉：呼噜噜秘藏瓶装满时，雅珂达不会立刻清空呼噜噜秘藏瓶，而是会在接下来的一段时间内，持续消耗瓶中装填的元素，并间歇性向附近的敌人发射软绒绒猫猫球，造成呼噜噜秘藏瓶对应元素类型的伤害。
hyperlinks.name: 呼噜噜秘藏瓶

hyperlinks.description:
曾是宝藏猎人的雅珂达随身携带的小道具之一，施放元素爆发秘器·猎人的七道具后取出。
猫型家用互助协调器将会持续为队伍中自己的当前场上角色恢复生命值；如果受到治疗的角色生命值高于70%，还会同时为队伍中附近生命值最低的角色恢复生命值。

月兆·满辉：若附近的敌人处于火元素、水元素、雷元素或冰元素附着下，猫型家用互助协调器将会转化为对应的元素类型，并会按照火元素、水元素、雷元素、冰元素的优先级进行转化。每次取出猫型家用互助协调器后，至多通过这种方式进行一次元素转化。触发元素转化后，猫型家用互助协调器将会间歇性攻击附近至多3名敌人，造成对应元素伤害。
hyperlinks.name: 猫型家用互助协调器

info.description: 十分可靠，无所不能（自称）的「秘闻馆」员工。
info.name: 雅珂达
info.title: 系风攘影

p1.description:
当队伍中存在至少1名元素类型为<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>、<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>或<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>的角色时，将依据对应元素类型的角色数量，使元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>秘器·猎人的七道具</color>中的{LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>{/LINK}获得强化。
雅珂达会偷偷记录队伍中上述元素类型的角色。在这些角色中，若角色数量最多的元素类型为：
·<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>：<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>造成原本130%的伤害；
·<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>：<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>造成原本120%的治疗量；
·<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>：<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>的数量增加一个；
·<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>：<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>的攻击间隔减少10%。

若上述元素类型的角色数量相同，则按照<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>、<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>、<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>的顺序进行记录。初始至多只有一种元素类型对应的效果生效。
p1.name: 索酬的巧计

p2.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>秘器·猎人的七道具</color>中的{LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>{/LINK}对队伍中自己的当前场上角色触发治疗时，若受到治疗的角色生命值高于70%，则该角色的元素精通提升100点，持续6秒。
p2.name: 蜜莓的嘉赏

p3.description: 雅珂达在队伍中时，队伍的<color=#FFD780FF>月兆</color>将会上升一级。
p3.name: 月兆祝赐·檐上趱行

p4.description:
在挪德卡莱执行探索派遣任务时，消耗的时间缩短25%。
\n此外，作为「秘闻馆」的雇员，雅珂达似乎可以通过某种方式获取各方的情报，而那夏镇的某些势力似乎对这些情报很有兴趣…
p4.name: 暗巷的黠慧

elementalburst.description: 压箱底的秘藏只能在这里用掉啦！雅珂达取出两枚{LINK#N11240002}猫型家用互助协调器{/LINK}，并对附近的敌人造成一次风元素伤害。\n\n「所谓互助协调嘛，就是你掏出摩拉互助，我们负责协调。怎么样，很合理吧？」
elementalburst.name: 秘器·猎人的七道具

elementalskill.description: 雅珂达向敌人突进，并在触及敌人时进入「掠影追袭」状态。处于该状态下时，雅珂达将持续快速移动；若附近的敌人处于火元素、水元素、雷元素或冰元素附着下，雅珂达还会偷偷将随身携带的{LINK#N11240001}呼噜噜秘藏瓶{/LINK}转换成对应的元素属性，并持续进行装填。持续时间结束或再次施放时，雅珂达将会清空呼噜噜秘藏瓶，并对附近的敌人造成一次风元素伤害；呼噜噜秘藏瓶装满时，雅珂达也会清空呼噜噜秘藏瓶，退出掠影追袭状态，并对附近的敌人造成一次伤害更高的风元素伤害。 如果雅珂达的突进没有触及敌人，雅珂达会在原地投掷下一枚烟雾弹，对身边的敌人造成一次风元素伤害。 月兆·满辉：呼噜噜秘藏瓶装满时，雅珂达不会立刻清空呼噜噜秘藏瓶，而是会在接下来的一段时间内，持续消耗瓶中装填的元素，并间歇性向附近的敌人发射软绒绒猫猫球，造成呼噜噜秘藏瓶对应元素类型的伤害。软绒绒猫猫球命中敌人时，还会为雅珂达恢复2点元素能量，该效果每3.5秒至多触发一次。 世上分配财富的方式很多，但对挪德卡莱的宝藏猎人与盗宝团而言，效率最高的分配方式从来都只有一种。
elementalskill.name: 奇策·财富分配方案

normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多三段的连续弓箭射击。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
进行伤害更高、更为精准的<color=#FFD780FF>瞄准射击</color>。
瞄准时，强风会在箭矢上持续积聚。聚满了强风之力的箭矢会造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中射出箭雨，并迅速下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，在落地时造成范围伤害。
normalattack.name: 见机行矢

constellations.desc: When a <color=#FFD780FF>Fluffy Meowball</color> fired by the {LINK#N11240001}<color=#FFD780FF>Purr-loined Treasure Flask</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils</color> hits an enemy, there is a 50% chance for it to bounce, dealing the corresponding Elemental DMG to nearby opponents.
constellations.name: One More Flask!

constellations.desc: <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: In the Ascension Talent {LINK#P1242101}<color=#FFD780FF>"Plan to Get Paid,"</color>{/LINK} Jahoda can secretly track, in addition to the element with the highest number of characters, the element with the next highest number of characters among the remaining types. This allows up to two elemental effects to be active at once. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Plan to Get Paid."
constellations.name: Rogue's Quick Thinking

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11245}Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Desperate Gamble

constellations.desc: When a {LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter</color> undergoes an Elemental Conversion, Jahoda will recover 4 Elemental Energy.
constellations.name: Wild Berry Amid the Dust

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11242}Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: The Greatest Treasure

constellations.desc: <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: After the {LINK#N11240001}<color=#FFD780FF>Purr-loined Treasure Flask</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils</color> is full, nearby Moonsign characters in your party have their CRIT Rate increased by 5% and CRIT DMG increased by 40% for 20s.
constellations.name: The Littlest Luck

passives.desc:
When your team has at least one <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>, or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> character, the {LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter</color> will be enhanced based on the number of characters of each corresponding element.
Jahoda secretly keeps track of these characters. Among them, the element with the highest number of characters determines the enhancement effect:
· <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>: <color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> deal 130% of their original DMG.
· <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>: <color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> heal for 120% of their original healing amount.
· <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>: The number of <color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> increases by one.
· <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>: The attack interval of <color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> is reduced by 10%.

If there's a tie between elements, the order of priority that determines which enhancement takes effect is: <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>, then <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>. Only one elemental effect can initially be triggered.
passives.name: Plan to Get Paid

passives.desc: When a {LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter</color> triggers healing on an active team member, if that character's HP is above 70%, their Elemental Mastery will be increased by 100 for 6s.
passives.name: Sweet Berry Bounty

passives.desc: When Jahoda is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.
passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Rooftop Dash

passives.desc: When dispatched on an expedition in Nod-Krai, time consumed is reduced by 25%.
passives.name: Backstreet Guile

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Performs a more precise <color=#FFD780FF>Aimed Shot</color> with increased DMG.
While aiming, mighty winds will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged wind arrow will deal <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, hitting opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Strike While the Arrow's Hot

skills.desc: Jahoda dashes toward her opponent, entering the Shadow Pursuit state upon contact. While in this state, Jahoda moves continuously and swiftly: If nearby opponents are affected by Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo, she will quietly convert her {LINK#N11240001}Purr-loined Treasure Flask{/LINK} to that element, gradually filling it. When the duration ends or the skill is used again, Jahoda drains the Purr-loined Treasure Flask and deals a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask is full, Jahoda immediately drains it, exiting the Shadow Pursuit state and dealing a more powerful instance of Anemo DMG. If her dash fails to make contact with an opponent, Jahoda instead drops a Smoke Bomb at her location, dealing a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask becomes full, Jahoda will not immediately discharge it. Instead, for a short duration, she steadily consumes the stored element inside and periodically fires Fluffy Meowballs at nearby opponents, dealing DMG of the corresponding element stored in the Purr-loined Treasure Flask. When a Fluffy Meowball hits an opponent, Jahoda regenerates 2 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 3.5s. There are many ways to divide wealth in this world — but for Nod-Krai's treasure hunters — and hoarders — only one has ever proven sufficiently effective.
skills.name: Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils

skills.desc: Time to reveal those pocket aces! Jahoda retrieves 2 {LINK#N11240002}Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots{/LINK} and deals a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents.\n\n"Coordinated assistance? It means you 'assist' some Mora our way, and we handle the 'coordination.' Makes purrfect sense, don't you agree?"
skills.name: Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter

constellations.name: 再来一瓶！

constellations.desc: <color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color>：突破天赋{LINK#P1242101}<color=#FFD780FF>「索酬的巧计」</color>{/LINK}中，除角色数量最多的元素类型外，雅珂达还可以偷偷记录剩余元素类型中角色数量最多的元素类型，并使至多两种元素类型对应的效果生效。该效果需要解锁突破天赋「索酬的巧计」。
constellations.name: 律贼的临机应变

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11245}秘器·猎人的七道具{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 无所依归的豪赌

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>秘器·猎人的七道具</color>中的{LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>{/LINK}发生元素转化时，将会为雅珂达回复4点元素能量。
constellations.name: 尘沙之上的野莓

constellations.desc: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11242}奇策·财富分配方案{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 最伟大的财宝

constellations.desc: <color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color>：元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>奇策·财富分配方案</color>中的{LINK#N11240001}<color=#FFD780FF>呼噜噜秘藏瓶</color>{/LINK}装满后的20秒内，队伍中附近的月兆角色的暴击率提升5%，暴击伤害提升40%。
constellations.name: 最渺小的幸运

passives.desc:
当队伍中存在至少1名元素类型为<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>、<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>或<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>的角色时，将依据对应元素类型的角色数量，使元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>秘器·猎人的七道具</color>中的{LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>{/LINK}获得强化。
雅珂达会偷偷记录队伍中上述元素类型的角色。在这些角色中，若角色数量最多的元素类型为：
·<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>：<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>造成原本130%的伤害；
·<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>：<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>造成原本120%的治疗量；
·<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>：<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>的数量增加一个；
·<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>：<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>的攻击间隔减少10%。

若上述元素类型的角色数量相同，则按照<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>、<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>、<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>的顺序进行记录。初始至多只有一种元素类型对应的效果生效。
passives.name: 索酬的巧计

passives.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>秘器·猎人的七道具</color>中的{LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>猫型家用互助协调器</color>{/LINK}对队伍中自己的当前场上角色触发治疗时，若受到治疗的角色生命值高于70%，则该角色的元素精通提升100点，持续6秒。
passives.name: 蜜莓的嘉赏

passives.name: 月兆祝赐·檐上趱行
